data.credibility: Management delivers well on primary core targets like revenue growth and EBITDA margins, but frequently drops or stops reporting secondary guidance metrics such as capex, R&D figures, and non-defense goals across subsequent quarters.

lines.line: Promised >27% EBITDA margin for FY26; delivered 29.2%.
Promised >INR 27,000 crores orders; achieved INR 19,300 crores by Q3.
Promised INR 57,000 crores order inflow including QRSAM; dropped tracking.
Promised >INR 1,600 crores R&D investment; dropped from updates.
Promised >INR 1,000 crores capex; dropped from subsequent updates.
Targeted 3% to 4% export turnover; dropped tracking.
Targeted 5% export turnover in 2 to 3 years; remains on track.
Targeted >INR 2,000 crores R&D next year; remains on track.
Aimed to cross 10% non-defense turnover; dropped.
Aimed for minimum INR 1,000 crores from data centers; dropped.
Targeted minimum 20% year-on-year R&D growth; dropped.
Retained >15% revenue growth for FY27; tracking 25.8% so far.
Guided >28% EBITDA margin for FY27; tracking 26.6% so far.
Expecting >INR 55,000 crores order inflow this year; remains on track.
Targeted ~INR 2,200 crores R&D investment this year; remains on track.
Targeted >INR 1,200 crores capital investment this year; remains on track.
Targeted USD 300 million in export orders this year; status is pending.

overrides.reason: Management explicitly stated they achieved INR 19,300 crores by Q3 against the full-year target of >INR 27,000 crores.

bull: Revenue compounded at 14.4% and net profit at 23.6% over five years, supported by a low debt/equity of 0.0.
EBITDA margin expanded from 22.8% in FY21 to 29.2% in FY26, alongside strong reported returns on equity of 27.5%.
Current FY27 performance shows strong momentum with 25.8% revenue growth across the first two quarters against a >15% target.
bear: Working-capital days stretched significantly from 47 to 135 days over the last five years.
Operating cash flow reached only 59% of reported profit over the five-year period, indicating a persistent profit-to-cash gap.
Current FY27 EBITDA margin is slipping at 26.6% compared to management's guidance of more than 28%.
